common.tagline: Rooms in Seoul for international guests
common.metaDescription: Find and book a room in Seoul. Prices in KRW with a USD reference.

auth.title: Log in
auth.intro: We'll email you a sign-in link. No password needed.
auth.sent: Check your email and open the sign-in link. It works on any device.

errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.send: We couldn't send the link. Please try again in a minute.
errors.oauth: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
errors.auth: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

search.heading: Find your room in Seoul
search.datesHint: Pick both dates to see only rooms free for your whole stay.
search.emptyHint: Try different dates, a wider rent range, or fewer filters.
search.mapUnavailable: The map is not available right now. The list shows every result.

issues.dates_incomplete: Enter both a move-in date and a last night to filter by dates. Dates were ignored.
issues.dates_order: The last night must not be before the move-in date. Dates were ignored.
issues.dates_past: Move-in must be at least 3 days from today. Dates were ignored.
issues.rent_invalid: The rent range was not valid, so it was ignored.
issues.district_invalid: Some districts were not recognized and were ignored.

house.noRooms: No rooms are listed in this house right now.
house.upTo: {count, plural, one {Up to # guest} other {Up to # guests}}

request.heading: Request to move in
request.stayHint: Stays are 1 to 12 months. Move-in must be at least 3 days from today.
request.genderOnly: {policy} guests only: every guest must match.
request.enterDates: Choose your move-in date and last night to see the price.
request.stayLength: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}{days, plural, =0 {} one { and # day} other { and # days}}
request.prorated: {days, plural, one {# extra day} other {# extra days}} (rent ÷ 30 per day)
request.firstRentShort: Your stay is under 2 months, so all of its rent is paid up front.
request.firstRentLong: One month from move-in. Later months are paid to the host after you move in.
request.noChargeYet: You won't be charged now. You pay only after the host approves your request.
request.cancellation: Cancellation: full refund until {date} 23:59 (KST), 7 days before move-in. After that, only the deposit is refunded. From the move-in day, the booking cannot be cancelled online.
request.loginHint: You need to log in to send a request. Your dates are kept.
request.messagePlaceholder: Your job or school, why you're coming to Seoul, questions…

invalid.contact: Enter a way to reach you (3–100 characters).
invalid.coOccupantName: Enter the second guest's name (up to 100 characters).

errors.ROOM_NOT_FOUND: This room could not be found.
errors.ROOM_NOT_PUBLISHED: This room is not open for booking.
errors.TOO_SOON: Move-in must be at least 3 days from today.
errors.BEFORE_AVAILABLE: This room is not available yet on that move-in date.
errors.GENDER_MISMATCH: This room's gender policy doesn't match every guest.
errors.TOO_MANY_OCCUPANTS: Too many guests for this room.
errors.ROOM_UNAVAILABLE: This room is already booked for some of these dates.
errors.PRICING: Stays must be at least 1 month and at most 12 months, and the last night can't be before move-in.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This can't be done in the booking's current state.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this booking.
errors.CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED: From the move-in day, the booking cannot be cancelled online.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This room could not be found or is no longer open for booking.

legal.draftBanner: Draft — legal review required before publishing

bookings.heading: My bookings
bookings.priceNote: Fixed when you sent the request.

notice.requested: The host is reviewing your request. If there is no reply by {time}, the request expires automatically.
notice.awaiting_payment: Your request was approved. Pay the first payment by {time} to confirm the booking. After that the room is released.
notice.confirmed: Your booking is confirmed. See you on move-in day!
notice.rejected: The host couldn't accept this request. You're welcome to request another room.
notice.request_expired: The host didn't reply in time, so this request expired. You can send a new request.
notice.payment_expired: The payment window closed and the room was released. You can send a new request.
notice.completed: This stay is complete. Thank you for staying with us!

bookings.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this request? This can't be undone.

refundPreview.full: If you cancel now, you get a full refund of {amount}.
refundPreview.deposit_only: The full-refund deadline has passed. If you cancel now, only the deposit is refunded: {amount}.
refundPreview.not_allowed: From the move-in day, the booking can't be cancelled online. Please contact us.

bookings.refundCharged: You paid in USD, so {amount} goes back to your payment method.
bookings.cancelConfirm: Cancel this booking? This can't be undone.
bookings.cancelDone: Your booking was cancelled. A refund of {amount} will be processed.
bookings.notFound: This booking could not be found.

pay.heading: Pay for your booking
pay.onlineLater: Online card and PayPal payment isn't available yet. Please pay by bank transfer.
pay.bankIntro: Transfer the exact amount in KRW to:
pay.memo: Write your booking reference {ref} in the transfer memo.
pay.afterTransfer: Once the operator confirms your transfer, we'll email you the booking confirmation.
pay.noBankInfo: Bank details aren't set up yet. Please contact us for payment instructions.
